name: Uniform reservoir sampling Algorithm R
definition: For t>k choose J uniformly from {1,…,t}; if J≤k replace reservoir slot J; P(item i retained after t)=k/t
variables: t stream count; k reservoir size; J uniform integer
assumptions: Fixed positive reservoir size, distinct observation identities, unbiased random draws; full review pending
limitations: Random sampling variation and no temporal stratification; review pending
failure_conditions: Invalid size, biased random generator or count overflow
computation: Fill k slots, then update using the stated random replacement; verify uniform subset proof and startup before admission.

source.citation: Provisional locator: Vitter (1985), Random sampling with a reservoir, ACM TOMS 11(1), 37–57. https://doi.org/10.1145/3147.3165; full review pending.

application: General uniform sampling of a finite stream; no empirical benefit claimed.
incompatible_methods: Treating samples as independent draws with replacement
mechanism_note: Provisional uniform sampling without replacement from unknown-length stream; distinct from rank summaries.

name: Boyer–Moore majority cancellation
definition: If c=0 set m=x,c=1; otherwise c←c+1 if x=m and c←c−1 otherwise; verify count(m)>N/2
variables: m candidate; c residual count; N total count
assumptions: Equality comparable observations; replay or guaranteed strict majority; full review pending
limitations: Candidate is not necessarily a majority without verification; not a mode estimator; review pending
failure_conditions: No replay and no majority guarantee, invalid equality semantics
computation: Cancel unequal pairs during a single pass; verify candidate in a second pass unless strict majority is guaranteed. Review original proof before admission.

source.citation: Provisional locator: Boyer and Moore (1991), MJRTY: A Fast Majority Vote Algorithm, pp. 105–117, DOI 10.1007/978-94-011-3488-0_5; full review pending.

application: General categorical stream majority detection; no empirical benefit claimed.
required_inputs: Equality-comparable stream and replay for verification.
incompatible_methods: Reporting an unverified candidate as a strict majority
mechanism_note: Provisional cancellation-based majority candidate; distinct from numeric quantile summaries.
